Render the run log to a PDF

Source: R/render_run.R
render_run.Rd

render_run() renders the run log <version>_results/run.md to <version>_results/run.pdf with Quarto and its Typst format. A run never calls it, so a missing Quarto cannot fail a run.

Usage

render_run(version, home = ".")

Arguments

version

The version, for example "v01".

home

The project folder. The default is the working directory.

Value

Invisibly, the path of run.pdf.

Details

save_results() writes run.md. render_run() needs the program quarto on the PATH. Quarto holds Typst, so the PDF needs no LaTeX. It stops when run.md does not exist, when Quarto is not installed, or when Quarto fails.

render_run() renders a copy of run.md in a temporary folder, with an A4 page, a 9 point font and narrow margins. So no file of Quarto stays in the results folder, and run.md stays as save_results() wrote it. It then copies run.pdf to a temporary file in <version>_results/, and renames it to run.pdf. So an interruption never leaves a part of the PDF.

run.pdf is generated output, and run.md is the form for git. Keep run.pdf out of git, for example with the line run.pdf in the .gitignore of the project. pbn does not write that line.

See also

vignette("pbn"), which shows the run log of a small fake project.

Other results: check_results(), read_results(), save_results()

Examples

home <- file.path(tempdir(), "pbn_render_example")
dir.create(file.path(home, "v01_results"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(
  c("# Run log", "", "| Scenario | Simulations |", "|---|---:|", "| real | 1 |"),
  file.path(home, "v01_results", "run.md")
)
if (nzchar(Sys.which("quarto"))) {
  pbn::render_run("v01", home = home)
}
unlink(home, recursive = TRUE)
